en.tagline: Talking head and avatar videos from a portrait and script
en.summary: This skill creates AI avatar and talking head videos through the inference.sh belt CLI. The recommended model, P-Video-Avatar, has built-in text-to-speech, so a portrait image and a text script are enough to produce a video. Other models cover audio-driven avatars, lipsync on existing video, and dubbing.
problem: Making a talking presenter video usually means recording a person or paying for a separate avatar service. The speech also has to match the lip movement. This skill handles that with the belt CLI: you give a portrait image and a script, and it returns a video of the face speaking.
The same workflow covers UGC-style ads with several presenters for one product, and dubbing an existing video into another language with new speech.
fit: Presenter or explainer videos made from one portrait photo
UGC-style ads with different presenters for the same product
Dubbing a video into another language
unfit: Videos with no face or speaker
Work outside the belt CLI, since every example runs through it
steps: Log in with `belt login` and install the belt CLI.
Choose a model, starting with `pruna/p-video-avatar`, which has built-in text-to-speech.
Pass a portrait image URL, a `voice_script`, and a `voice` such as `Zephyr (Female)`.
Add optional fields such as `voice_prompt`, `video_prompt`, `voice_language`, and `resolution` to set tone, background, and output size.
For models without built-in TTS, such as OmniHuman, generate speech first with Inworld TTS-2 and pass the audio URL as `audio`.
If you have no portrait, create one with `pruna/p-image` at the `9:16` aspect ratio for vertical video.

zh.tagline: 用肖像图和文字脚本生成数字人说话视频
zh.summary: 这个技能通过 inference.sh 的 belt CLI 生成 AI 数字人和说话头像视频。推荐模型 P-Video-Avatar 内置语音合成，只需一张人像图和一段文字脚本即可生成视频。其他模型支持音频驱动的数字人、已有视频的口型同步和配音。
problem: 制作口播视频通常需要真人录制，或者购买单独的数字人服务，而且语音还要与口型对上。这个技能通过 belt CLI 处理这一步：你提供人像图和脚本，它返回人脸说话的视频。
同一流程还可以制作同一产品、不同出镜人的 UGC 风格广告，也可以用新语音把已有视频配音成其他语言。
fit: 用一张人像照片制作口播或讲解视频
为同一产品制作不同出镜人的 UGC 风格广告
把视频配音成其他语言
unfit: 画面中没有人脸或说话人的视频
不使用 belt CLI 的场景，因为所有示例都通过它运行
steps: 运行 `belt login` 登录，并安装 belt CLI。
选择模型，建议从 `pruna/p-video-avatar` 开始，它内置文字转语音。
传入人像图片 URL、`voice_script`，以及 `Zephyr (Female)` 之类的 `voice`。
按需添加 `voice_prompt`、`video_prompt`、`voice_language` 和 `resolution`，设置语气、背景和输出尺寸。
对于没有内置语音合成的模型，例如 OmniHuman，先用 Inworld TTS-2 生成语音，再把音频 URL 作为 `audio` 传入。
如果没有人像图，可用 `pruna/p-image` 并设置 `9:16` 宽高比生成竖版人像。
